# Digital product development

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The work that takes a digital product from an idea to software in use. It covers what to build, what the people who use it need, how the product presents itself, what it says, how people operate it, and how it is engineered.

## References

- You define or apply the identity of a product. Read [Brand design](brand-design.md).
- You plan or write the content of a product. Read [Content design](content-design.md).
- You decide what a product does or who it serves. Read [Product strategy](product-strategy.md).
- You write, test, or release software. Read [Software engineering](software-engineering.md).
- You design a screen, a flow, or an interface element. Read [UI/UX design](ui-ux-design.md).
- You study the people who use a product. Read [User research](user-research.md).
